name: 朝鲜民画
palette: 高纯石青、石绿、朱红、粉白与墨黑，纸纤维上的矿物色对比鲜明
lighting: 平面设色、少量装饰性阴影，不使用真人电影光或西方体积塑形
optics: 扁平或逆透视空间，器物层叠而保持每一形体可读
composition: 朴拙比例、装饰平衡和象征性自然/器物母题形成亲切而有秩序的民间画面
camera_motion: ornamental lateral drift, layered reverse-perspective reveal, gentle tableau push, motif-led transition
style_instructions: Korean minhwa folk painting, bold mineral colors, paper texture, playful naïve proportions, flattened or reverse perspective and balanced symbolic decorative motifs.
avoid_instructions: No Chinese paper-cut symmetry, no Japanese woodblock waves, no Western linear realism, no live-action shading, no generic East Asian mashup, no text or watermark.
